usedFor: Changes in actiTIME, such as “Task Created” or “Project Updated”, get written into a tab of a Google Docs document.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Created” in actiTIME, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new task can add its text to a chosen tab, or replace what that tab held.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab’s content, so check its mode before using a shared doc.
